description: Budget for Zig tests that skip themselves, read by scripts/check-test-skips.ps1 (PKG-76, F207). allowedSkips lists the tests in the guarded family that may skip on that runner; a skip outside it fails, because a shaping or metrics test that stops running looks like green CI. maxTotalSkipped is the total across the whole suite. Lower a number when a skip goes away. Raise one only with the reason in the commit message.
